_doc: Deep scuttler (M5-A3P-1805, Ch17): the scuttler's spawn carapace, darker and more wounded: its wide-open seams and the raw wounds through its plates glow brighter and pulse faster than the Act I scuttler's (the Calm failing), its barbs drier at their bone tips. write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
